result.topic_en: Period matrices of a theta function (with half-periods α−β added), the transformation behaviour of a theta quotient across the cuts a_ν and b_ν, and a degeneration in which a_{1,1} → −∞; side calculations, partly rotated, on Taylor expansions and on local behaviour of the form (z−α)^n(s−β)^m.
